senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בז to divide, to distribute, to make spoil. Y. Macc. II, 31ᵈ bot. היה בוֹזֵז made booty.—Part. pass. בָּזוּז, f. בְּזוּזָה robbed, illegitimately conquered.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:6">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ב׳ היא בידכם</he> it is robbery what ye possess (ye have no title).
